schema.text: Does it seem reasonable that the app asks for access to your camera?

en.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Does it seem reasonable that the app asks for access to your camera?

fr.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Vous semble-t-il raisonnable que l’application demande l’accès à votre appareil photo ?

it.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Ti sembra ragionevole che l’app chieda l’accesso alla tua fotocamera?

de.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Finden Sie es nachvollziehbar, dass die App Zugriff auf Ihre Kamera anfordert?

tr.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Uygulamanın kameranıza erişim istemesi size makul görünüyor mu?

hu.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: Észszerűnek tűnik, hogy az alkalmazás hozzáférést kér a kamerájához?

fa.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: آیا به نظرتان معقول است که برنامه دسترسی به دوربین شما را درخواست کند؟

ar.#Does it seem reasonable that the app as: هل يبدو لك معقولًا أن يطلب التطبيق الوصول إلى الكاميرا لديك؟
